narration.v2: 在彈出視窗，先填活動名稱，例如『RegMaster 示範春季賽』。選擇活動類別，這裡選競賽。再選活動形式為個人報名。下方的容量上限可以先留空，之後再到設定頁細調。確認資料後按下『建立』，系統會立刻產生活動，並把你帶到詳細設定頁，整個流程不到十秒。

narration.v4: 接著設定關鍵時間：開放報名時間是活動可以被報名的起點；報名截止時間到了會自動關閉新報名；活動日則是實際舉行的日期。RegMaster 會根據時間自動切換活動狀態，從草稿到開放，再到截止，全程不必手動切換按鈕，省心又安全。
narration.v5: 最後右下角按下『儲存變更』，所有設定立刻生效。回到『所有活動』清單，剛建立的活動已顯示在列表上，狀態是草稿，隨時可以繼續編輯。骨架完成後，下一步就是設定組別與規則，繼續往下走。

narration_en.v1: Creating an event is simple. In the organizer dashboard, choose 'All Events' on the left, then click the 'Create Event' button in the top-right, and the process begins instantly. RegMaster's philosophy is to build the skeleton of your event first, then fill in the details bit by bit. Every step saves automatically, so you can leave partway through and pick up right where you left off without losing anything.
narration_en.v2: In the pop-up window, start with the event name, for example 'RegMaster Spring Showcase.' Choose the event type, here we'll pick 'Competition.' Then set the registration format to 'Individual.' You can leave the capacity limit blank for now and fine-tune it later in settings. Confirm the details and click 'Create,' and the system creates the event right away and takes you to the detailed settings page, all in under ten seconds.
narration_en.v3: On the detailed settings page, under 'Basic Information,' the event name is already filled in. The description field below supports basic HTML and appears directly in the 'About this event' section of your public page, helping registrants understand the theme and rules. We recommend clearly describing the event's background, who it's for, and contact details. It greatly reduces inquiry emails and saves you a lot of support time.
narration_en.v4: Next, set the key dates: the registration open date is when people can start signing up; when the registration deadline arrives, new registrations close automatically; and the event date is when it actually takes place. RegMaster switches the event status automatically based on these times, from draft to open to closed, with no manual buttons to toggle. It's effortless and reliable.
narration_en.v5: Finally, click 'Save Changes' in the bottom-right, and all your settings take effect immediately. Back in the 'All Events' list, the event you just created appears with a 'Draft' status, ready to keep editing anytime. With the skeleton in place, the next step is setting up divisions and rules. Let's keep going.

02.outro_en: That's it for this episode. Tap the button below to watch the next one: 'Divisions, Age Rules & Team Names.' Or visit regmaster-pro.web.app for the full tutorial series.

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片我們聚焦在『報名組別』。組別是活動結構的骨架，設計得好，後面整套金流、評分、證書都能順著跑。活動建立完成後，下一步是設定報名組別。在『設定』的『組別』分頁，你可以區隔不同年齡層、能力等級或主題的選手分組。系統內建了常見組別預設，例如國小、國中、高中、社會組，可以直接選用，省去逐一輸入的時間。組別越清楚，後續評分、排名、發證書就越順。
narration.v2: 點選『新增組別』，輸入組別名稱，例如『公開組』。每個組別都可以單獨設定年齡規則：選擇『不限年齡』、依『年齡區間』、或依『出生日期區間』。設好之後，系統會在報名時自動驗證選手的生日。這對於常見的『未滿幾歲不得報名』或『跨組混報』糾紛特別有用。
narration.v3: 下方的『隊伍命名』區塊，讓你決定報名時是否要求填寫隊伍名稱。可以分別開啟『要求中文隊名』顯示為公開頁的隊伍識別，或『要求英文隊名』用於國際性活動或證書印製。團體賽通常兩者都打開，個人賽則可以全部關閉。組別與隊名設定好之後，下一步是調整報名表單。組別與隊名設定完成，活動的人員分層就架好了。下一部我們會繼續往表單設計器走，把每位選手要填的欄位也客製化。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode focuses on registration divisions. Divisions are the backbone of your event's structure; design them well, and payments, scoring, and certificates all flow smoothly afterward. Once your event is created, the next step is setting up divisions. In the 'Divisions' tab under 'Settings,' you can separate participants by age group, skill level, or theme. The system comes with common presets, like Elementary, Junior High, High School, and Open, that you can select directly, saving you from typing each one. The clearer your divisions, the smoother scoring, ranking, and certificates will be.
narration_en.v2: Click 'Add Division' and enter a name, such as 'Open Division.' Each division can have its own age rule: choose no age limit, an age range, or a date-of-birth range. Once set, the system automatically validates each participant's birth date at registration. This is especially useful for the common 'must be over a certain age' requirement, or for preventing disputes over cross-division entries.
narration_en.v3: In the 'Team Naming' section below, you decide whether a team name is required at registration. You can separately enable a required Chinese team name, shown as the team's public identifier, or a required English team name, used for international events or certificate printing. Team competitions usually turn on both, while individual events can leave them off. With divisions and team names in place, your event's participant structure is set. In the next episode, we'll move on to the form designer and customize the fields each participant fills in.

narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片講『收費設定』，從費用項目、付款方式到折扣碼，三個區塊配合得好，營收結構就立得起來。回到活動設定，切到『收費』分頁。RegMaster 支援多項費用，例如報名費、保險費、餐點費，每一項都可以單獨命名、設金額，並決定是否必選。系統會在報名最後一步自動加總，不必手算。對於有早鳥、優惠、學生票的活動，可以建多個項目並用條件控制。
narration.v2: 付款方式區可以同時打開『銀行轉帳』與『PayUNI 線上付款』。銀行轉帳適合熟悉對帳的主辦方，PayUNI 則支援信用卡與超商代碼，報名者體驗最順。兩者也可以同時開放，由報名者自己選。如果是高金額活動，PayUNI 線上付款能大幅降低未繳費的流失。
narration.v3: 下方『折扣碼』區，可以建立早鳥碼、團報碼或推廣合作碼。每個碼可以設定折抵金額或折扣百分比，以及可使用次數上限。折扣碼非常適合分階段行銷，例如三月前用 EARLY200 折兩百元、四月團報碼 GROUP500 帶五人享優惠，效果立竿見影。收費架構打好，活動的營收基礎就穩了。下一部我們處理退費政策、上限與三種錄取模式，把營運邊界完整劃清楚。

Each code can be set to a fixed discount amount or a percentage, along with a usage limit. With your fee structure in place, your event's revenue foundation is solid. narration.v1: 歡迎回到 RegMaster 教學。本部影片把『退費政策、報名上限、錄取模式』三件事一次講清楚，這些是常見糾紛來源，預先設定好能省下後續大量客服。退費政策區，建議直接套用 RegMaster 提供的標準範本，再依活動性質調整。常見規則是:活動前十天全額退、十天內七折退、三天內不退。寫清楚可以避免後續糾紛，公開頁也會自動顯示這段條款。退費條款是消保法的重點，把它寫好就少一半的客服爭議。
narration.v2: 報名上限提供總額上限、各組別上限、以及候補名單功能。打開候補後，達到上限時報名者可以排隊，前面有人取消會自動遞補並寄信通知，特別適合熱門賽事。候補機制讓你不必反覆手動調整名額，名額用滿到開賽的這段時間，系統會幫你顧好。
narration.v3: RegMaster 提供三種錄取模式:『先到先得』適合公開賽事;『主辦審核』適合需要審資格的競賽，所有報名先進待審清單;『自訂正取』則讓主辦完整掌控錄取名單，適合邀請賽或國家隊選拔。三選一後儲存，整個活動的營運邏輯就定案了。三大政策一旦定案，活動的營運邏輯就明確了。下一部我們會把活動推上線，正式開放報名。

narration_en.v1: Welcome back to the RegMaster tutorials. This episode explains three things at once: refund policy, registration caps, and acceptance modes. These are common sources of disputes, and setting them up in advance saves you a lot of support work later. In the refund policy area, we recommend applying RegMaster's standard template directly, then adjusting it to fit your event. A common rule is: full refund up to ten days before the event, 70% within ten days, and no refund within three days. Spelling it out prevents disputes, and your public page displays the terms automatically. Refund terms are a key point under consumer protection law; get them right, and you'll cut customer-service disputes in half.
narration_en.v2: Registration caps offer a total cap, per-division caps, and a waitlist feature. With the waitlist on, registrants can queue once the cap is reached; when someone ahead cancels, the next person is promoted automatically and notified by email, perfect for popular events. The waitlist means you don't have to keep adjusting capacity by hand; from the moment you're full until the event begins, the system looks after it for you.
narration_en.v3: RegMaster offers three acceptance modes. First-come, first-served suits open events. Organizer review suits competitions that require vetting, where every registration goes into a pending-review list first. And Manual selection gives the organizer full control over the accepted list, ideal for invitationals or national-team trials. Pick one and save, and your event's operating logic is settled. With these three policies locked in, your operational logic is clear. In the next episode, we'll take the event live and officially open registration.

This is a pivotal moment for your event. Once the skeleton, divisions, form, and fees are all set, head back to event settings. If you haven't added one, the system blocks you and prompts you to add it in the form designer first. With that in place, your event meets the minimum bar to go public.
narration_en.v2: Once the check passes, click 'Open Registration,' and the event status switches to 'Accepting Registrations' immediately. The system presents a public link alongside a QR code: the public link is your share URL, and the QR code can be printed on posters or flyers so people can scan straight to the registration page. After opening, every registration from the public page flows into your dashboard in real time.
narration_en.v3: Click 'Preview Public Page' to check how everything looks from the registrant's point of view: cover image, summary, divisions, fees, and the register button all in place. We recommend sending this link to a colleague or partner for a quick test run, then making final tweaks before you start promoting with confidence. Everything on the public page comes from your earlier settings, and it syncs instantly whenever you save changes in the dashboard. Once your event is live, the real operational challenge is just beginning. In the next episode, we'll move on to managing your registration list, how to organize it and import and export it.
